user: And what are the typical timelines?
answer:
What I did
- Opened dispute ID 1 for TX-0401 and queued a human review (escalation queued).

What I found (typical timelines)
- Card reason codes: review target 10 business days.  
- Transfer reason codes: review target 20 business days.  
- Complex cases (for example, involvement of a foreign acquirer) can run up to 45 calendar days; we will notify you if the timeline is extended.  
- If we request supporting evidence, you will have 7 calendar days to supply it; failure to provide requested evidence within that window may result in the case being declined.

What happens next
- A human agent will pick up escalation_id 1, confirm whether the card or transfer timeline applies to TX-0401, and contact you by the email on file if they need evidence or additional information.  
- If you want to add evidence now or withdraw the dispute while it’s open, tell me and I will take that action on your behalf.
